hohtrials-bit0.title: Pass Trydan Faye's trial and defeat Rydda`Dar
hohtrials-bit0.why: This is the first of three trials in the Halls of Honor. You need all three to enter the Temple of Marr and get credit for Mithaniel Marr.

actions.text: Say 'ready' to Trydan Faye in the Halls of Honor. He vanishes and a Custodian of Marr appears in his spot.
Attack the Custodian within 10 seconds or it vanishes. Kill it in Trydan's room, do not pull it away.
Rydda`Dar appears where the Custodian died. Kill it in the same room and keep fighting it.
A new Trydan Faye appears. Everyone in the raid hails him.

npcs.where: Stands in his room in the Halls of Honor.

npcs.name: A Custodian of Marr
npcs.where: Appears in Trydan's spot when you say 'ready'.

npcs.name: Rydda`Dar
npcs.where: Appears where the Custodian died.

npcs.name: Trydan Faye (after the trial)
npcs.where: Appears in Trydan's spot after Rydda`Dar dies.

hohtrials-bit0.works_when: You see 'An ethereal mist descends from the air and surrounds your very being. Your body begins to emanate with the power of Trydan Faye.' There is no 'character flag' line for trials.
hohtrials-bit0.credit: Everyone in the raid that killed Rydda`Dar. If there was no raid, the killer's group, or the killer alone. Each person must hail.
needs: You killed Aerin`Dar in the Plane of Valor and stepped through the Halls of Honor portal.

You have permission to enter the Halls of Honor. You get it from the Halls of Honor portal in the Plane of Valor once you have the Aerin`Dar flag. There is also an alternate way in through the Plane of Tranquility portal.
You have not already passed this trial.
if_it_failed: Engage Rydda`Dar right away. If nobody fights it for 56 seconds it leaves, the trial fails and Trydan returns 10 minutes later.
If the Custodian vanished, nobody attacked it within 10 seconds. Trydan comes back a second later, so say 'ready' again.
Keep both mobs in the room. If pulled out they run home, forget who they were fighting and cast Balance of the Nameless.
Hail the new trial leader from inside the winning raid. If you are not in it, he ignores you with no text.
He leaves 10 minutes after he appears. Hail him straight away.
If he says 'You have already received credit for completing this trial', you already have it.
He can credit at most 72 people per run.
hohtrials-bit0.tips: The game remembers the winning raid until the zone restarts, so earlier winners can still hail. After a win the room's other mobs return on an 18 hour timer. Saying 'hail' or 'trials' to Trydan before the trial only gives story text.

agnarr-access.title: Climb the Torden tower to Agnarr the Storm Lord
agnarr-access.why: Agnarr sits at the top of the tower in the Bastion of Thunder. Killing him brings out Karana, who gives the next Storms flag.

actions.text: In the Bastion of Thunder, click the tower portal with the Symbol of Torden on your cursor. The Symbol goes onto your keyring. Your raid or group then has 5 minutes to click up too.
Kill Evynd Firestorm. Askr the Lost appears.
Each player says 'transport' to Askr to move up to the next level.
Kill Emmerik Skyfury. Askr the Lost appears again.
Say 'what storm' to Askr. A Chaotic Vortex appears.
Right-click the Chaotic Vortex (like opening a merchant) to move up to Agnarr's level.
Kill Agnarr the Storm Lord. Karana appears.

solusek-chamber.why: The lava runes move you into Solusek Ro's chamber. They only let you through once all five cauldrons and Rallos Zek are done.

actions.text: Click either set of lava runes in the Tower of Solusek Ro. You are moved into the chamber.

solusek-chamber.tips: Players can end up in the chamber other ways, such as a raid summon. The projection still needs all five cauldrons.

pofire-2-projection.title: Kill Solusek Ro and hail his projection
pofire-2-projection.why: This gives you the Plane of Fire flag. Miak then adjusts the Plane of Tranquility portal so you can enter the Plane of Fire.

actions.text: Kill Solusek Ro in his chamber in the Tower of Solusek Ro. Do not drag him down out of his chamber below half health. He heals hugely and calls a Guardian of Fire.
A Planar Projection appears. Everyone in the raid hails it.

npcs.name: Solusek Ro
npcs.where: In his chamber in the Tower of Solusek Ro.

npcs.name: A Planar Projection
npcs.where: Appears in the chamber after Solusek Ro dies and stays 20 minutes.

pofire-2-projection.works_when: Miak's thoughts say 'The portal into the Plane of Fire lies within the Lava Well of Ro.' Then 'You have received a character flag!'
pofire-2-projection.credit: Everyone in the raid that killed Solusek Ro. If there was no raid, the killer's group, or the killer alone. Each person must hail for themselves.

pofire-2-projection.tips: Any saved memory of Solusek Ro is cleared when this works.

needs: You have the Cipher of Druzzil from Maelin.
You brought both Zek note packs to Maelin and Maelin sent you after Rallos Zek.
You have a saved memory of Solusek Ro.
You killed Rallos Zek the Warlord and hailed his projection.
if_it_failed: If the Seer says 'you still must prove your warrior's spirit', kill Rallos Zek the Warlord first.
Sit down before you speak. If you stand, the Seer says 'You will never be able to focus unless you are relaxed.'
Your sentence must contain both words 'unlock' and 'memories'.
If the Seer says 'no recent events spark a memory', you have no saved memory to unlock.
pofire-2-seer.tips: The Seer does not check Miak or the cauldrons here. The Seer also unlocks all your other saved memories in the same say.
